verdict.rationale: Reflect's evidence shows no native, user-definable rule or trigger engine. What it does show are fixed automatic behaviors (Kindle sync, bookmarks and transcriptions added to the daily note) and manually invoked custom AI prompts. The Zapier connection is an external tool where any trigger logic would live, and the API and deep links expose only append and list actions with no event triggers or webhooks, so none of this credits the story.
